title: Horizon Implementation Day: Finding opportunities and submitting a proposal
summary: Commission session for newcomers: how Horizon Europe works, how to find calls and partners on the Funding & Tenders Portal and how to submit a proposal.
body: This live session from the European Commission's Horizon Implementation Day series is aimed at organisations that want to apply for Horizon Europe funding. It was streamed on 24 September 2026.

The agenda starts with a general introduction to Horizon Europe, then shows how to search for calls and potential partners on the Funding & Tenders Portal, and ends with how to prepare and submit a proposal: the proposal template, the basic principles and the evaluation criteria. Each part is followed by questions and answers.
why: Ullswater Investments note: a good starting point for companies applying to Horizon Europe for the first time. Understanding the evaluation criteria before writing is what separates a fundable proposal from a good idea on paper.
